items.name: G-Shock Origin
items.tagline: One square shape, from a single-line brief in 1983 to full metal.
items.intro: In 1981 Kikuo Ibe proposed "a durable watch that would not break even if dropped". The result, the DW-5000C, floats its module inside a shock-absorbing case. Its square shape has been in production ever since, gaining backlights, solar power, radio time-sync, Bluetooth and finally a full-metal case.

items.name: Rolex Submariner
items.tagline: Seventy years of the dive watch that defined the dive watch.
items.intro: Shown at the 1954 Basel fair, the Submariner set the template every dive watch still follows: a rotating timing bezel, a legible luminous dial and a sealed Oyster case. Follow it from the 37 mm 6204 through crown guards, the date window, sapphire crystal and ceramic bezels to today's 41 mm references.
